---
title: "Caffeine Intake as a Function of Coffee Preferences"
---

## Created by: Emma Cunningham and Anna Fratto

>Project Goal: Our project intends to investigate how varying coffee preferences affect caffeine usage. We plan to test different variables such as time of day (when making the coffee), cream use, coffee type, etc., and see how that impacts the amount of caffeine someone consumes.

##2-3 Broad Research Questions:
- What are the trends and general preferences of coffee drinkers in the US? 
- What factors influence coffee intake?
- What are the top influencers in consumer decisions to drink coffee at home vs. out? 
- What do people add when making their ideal order/coffee?  

##Project Inspiration 
- We wanted to focus on a health related topic 
- We are curious about caffeine intake within college students, but data might be restricted 

##Potential Data Source:
- The Great American Coffee Taste Test - Tidy Tuesday (2024)
- https://github.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/blob/main/data/2024/2024-05-14/readme.md
